amendments.decision: The 753 inventoried round-1 copies are a checkpoint prerequisite (design 21.5), not a per-plan deliverable, so no plan can clear them and no plan gets tmp/car1-r1/* in writePaths. The per-plan stray-test condition becomes 'this plan added no *.test.ts under target/ or tmp/': the plan-delta scan (perPlanStrayCheck) must print nothing and exit 0. The absolute scan is unchanged; it remains integrationGates[0] and [4] and stays blocked on the operator-run archive in checkpointPrerequisites[0].
amendments.perPlanStrayCheck: find target tmp -name '*.test.ts' -print | LC_ALL=C sort | LC_ALL=C comm -23 - tmp/car3-r3b/checkpoint/inventory-sorted.txt > tmp/car3-r3b/<planId>/stray-delta.txt && test ! -s tmp/car3-r3b/<planId>/stray-delta.txt
amendments.perPlanStrayCheckInput: tmp/car3-r3b/checkpoint/inventory-sorted.txt is archived-inventory.txt sorted with LC_ALL=C (753 lines). It is read-only for every plan.
amendments.resumeForBlockedPlans: g1a and g1b keep their source edits; each reruns only its existing crate gate and the perPlanStrayCheck, records both in its progress log, and sets status done. Neither reimplements anything.

amendments.decision: The g1e fail-before run (tmp/car3-r3b/car3-g1e-production-layers/fail-before.log, exit 101) aborted on 'Option quiet given more than once' before any assertion, and a pre-fix rebuild is a non-goal. The criterion is kept, with substitute evidence instead of a historical rerun. S1: the preserved pre-edit raster.rs copy (raster-before-edit.txt line 54 'translucent: Option<Hit>,') shows the single-slot production model. S2: tmp/car3-r3b/car3-g1d-reference-layers/fail-before.log shows the identical single-slot model failing the identical sheets_over_board pixel assertion ('board interior', 1 passed, 2 failed, exit 101). S3: tests.rs layers_check_sheets uses the same coordinates and all-Drawn check, and compare_every_thread_count compares production with the composited reference. No source edits, and no change to plan IDs, writePaths, dependsOn or waves.
amendments.resumeForBlockedPlans: g1e follows its plan section 'Amendment 2026-11-25 (blocked-wave-scope-or-contract, round 2)': write fail-before-substitute.log from three greps, rerun its three verification commands into gate-r2.log, focused-r2.log and stray-r2.log (exit 0, tests > 0, never add -q because CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true already sets quiet), and set its progress status done.
amendments.amendmentBudget: This is the second and last amendment (maxAmendmentRounds 2).

requiredOutcomes: R3-1 (g1a-g1c, g1g): stacked caps and opposed-frame shared side give zero candidates, zero pairs and no hatch in both rasterizers at threads 0 and 1-8; 0.01 mm controls give one pair; disjoint_scene(50) keeps pre-edit reads and charged with witness 0; stacked-cap charged equals never-flag charged plus witness; native touching cases exit 0, controls exit 1.

R3-2 (g1d-g1g): every translucent layer in front of the nearest opaque hit is composited in (depth, body) order and marked drawn in both rasterizers; opaque foreground hides the board; single-layer bytes and reads unchanged; capped worker arena refuses over-cap input with the existing message from its first checkpoint; layer_capacity <= C on staggered and band-boundary stripes; native PCB plus STL sheet lists the board drawn.
Integration: stray-test scan, bun run typecheck, bun run lint, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run test-cli and the stray-test scan again all exit 0.
nonGoals: Editing interference.rs, overlay.rs, capture-interference-options.ts, capture-help.ts, NCS1 readers or writers, or any TypeScript scene code.
Changing messages, exit codes, limits, or goldens other than the R3-1 touching-contact and R3-2 overlap-condition cases.
Building an older commit or a pre-fix binary; re-dispatching the other car3 plans.
Editing impl-plans/README.md, lockfiles or indexes, workspace-wide formatting, git commits, branches or worktrees during plan execution.
constraints: Work only in this working tree on feat/ai-capture; no push, no history rewrite, no other worktrees; no server, auth, secrets or deployment config.
AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/<planId>.
Per-pixel and per-byte work stays in Rust; captures deterministic.
Never relax or delete existing tests or deadlines; timing tests may be retried up to three times.
Per-plan verification focused; workspace typecheck, lint, verify and test-cli only at integration.
No plan adds a *.test.ts under target/ or tmp/: each plan's perPlanStrayCheck (amendments[0]) must print nothing and exit 0. The absolute no-*.test.ts scan is integrationGates[0] and [4].

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Cast flag (g1a) separate from the production witness (g1c).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Folding it in exceeds the four-file limit; it is the semantic core of R3-1 (design 21.5).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Reference plans (g1b, g1d) precede their production counterparts (g1c, g1e).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The reference is the oracle; production then adds equality at every thread count.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The storage cap and its refusal land with the arena in g1e; g1f adds only the layer_capacity statistic and lifecycle tests.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: No checkpoint or native build has an uncapped arena (R3B-CAP-AT-ACTIVATION).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: g1c records disjoint_scene(50) reads and charged literals after a telemetry-only step and before the witness edit.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: An independent baseline catches charges added to both flag paths (R3B-CHARGE-BASELINE).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: render_with keeps its signature; a new render_tuned(scene, threads, allowance, Tuning) carries the never-flag switch and the layer cap.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Existing exact-count tests stay byte-identical; production passes Tuning::PRODUCTION.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-25 round 1: the per-plan stray-test condition becomes the plan-delta scan (no *.test.ts added under target/ or tmp/ beyond the 753-line tmp/car3-r3b/checkpoint/inventory-sorted.txt); the absolute scan stays integrationGates[0] and [4], blocked on the operator-run archive in checkpointPrerequisites[0].
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plans car3-g1a-cast-flag and car3-g1b-reference-witness: both failed only the absolute stray-test scan on 753 pre-existing tmp/car1-r1 copies outside their writePaths. Resolved gap: no plan owns tmp/car1-r1 and no scan exclusions are added; g1a and g1b keep their source edits and resume by rerunning the crate gate and the delta scan. Plan IDs, dependsOn, waves and writePaths are unchanged.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-25 round 2: car3-g1e-production-layers keeps its fail-before acceptance criterion but proves it with substitute evidence S1-S3 (the pre-edit raster.rs copy with the single-slot translucent model, the g1d reference fail-before on identical sheet assertions, and the production/reference compare_every_thread_count check), recorded in tmp/car3-r3b/car3-g1e-production-layers/fail-before-substitute.log. The invalid fail-before.log stays byte-unchanged, and -q is never combined with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plan car3-g1e-production-layers: its fail-before.log exited 101 on a duplicate quiet option before any assertion ran, and a pre-fix rebuild is a non-goal. Resolved gap: amendments[1] and plans[g1e].acceptanceCriteria[1] define the substitute evidence, and the resume needs no source edits. Plan IDs, dependsOn, waves, writePaths and verification are unchanged. This is the last amendment round (maxAmendmentRounds 2).

intentionalTradeoffs: Seven plans instead of the five-plan example, to keep one aspect and about four files per plan.
Sibling compile races in the shared tree are handled by rerun after the sibling is done (worker rule 10).
Native cases are regression guards; fail-before evidence is the Rust tests.
supportedEdgeCases: Shared cap and shared side with opposed frames at every thread count; 0.01 mm overlaps still reported.
One to five translucent layers per sample; opaque foreground; single-layer scenes byte-identical.
Band restart, rotation and unsampled bottom row of the layer arena; over-cap refusal.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Desktop pixels, cross-platform determinism and Boa elapsed time (unmeasured residual risks).
